# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V3030 effect_ceiling_exceeded"
description: "A pub fn of a package requires a std effect that the package's ceiling does not list (RFC 0003 §5.1, experimental)."
---

An error from the `effect` phase. `sakura explain V3030` prints this explanation offline.

A `pub fn` of a package requires a std effect that the package's ceiling does not list (RFC
0003 §5.1, experimental). `[package] effects` in `sakura.toml` is the ceiling: the std effects
the package's public functions may require. The check unions the std effects in every `pub fn`'s
row (user-defined effects, `Fail` and `Test` are not counted) and reports each `pub fn` whose row
goes beyond the ceiling. A package without an `effects` key has no ceiling and no check; `effects
= []` is a pure package. Either remove the effect from the function or widen the ceiling, which
every consumer then has to accept on its dependency line (`V8032`).

Wrong:

```sakura
# sakura.toml
[package]
name = "stamp"
effects = ["Clock"]
# src/lib.sak
pub fn log_now() -> Unit ! {Clock, Console} { Console.print("{Clock.monotonic_micros()}") }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
pub fn now() -> Int ! {Clock} { Clock.monotonic_micros() }
```

[`compiler/tests/ui/V3030_effect_ceiling_exceeded/`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V3030_effect_ceiling_exceeded/), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

`lib.sak`:

```sakura
// RFC 0003 §5.1: a `pub fn` whose row has a std effect beyond `[package] effects` is `V3030` at
// the function; private functions and user-defined effects do not count.

pub fn log_now() -> Unit ! {Clock, Console} { Console.print("{Clock.monotonic_micros()}") }

pub fn now() -> Int ! {Clock} { Clock.monotonic_micros() }

fn shout(s: String) -> Unit ! {Console} { Console.print(s) }
```

`sakura.toml`:

```toml
[package]
name = "stamp"
version = "0.1.0"
effects = ["Clock"]
```
